from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for y in range(3 * h):
        tile_y = y // h
        sy0 = y % h
        sy = h - 1 - sy0 if tile_y in (0, 2) else sy0
        row = []
        for x in range(2 * w):
            tile_x = x // w
            sx0 = x % w
            sx = w - 1 - sx0 if tile_x == 0 else sx0
            row.append(grid[sy][sx])
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-9c84485b.py'
p.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_9c84485b',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
res=mod.transform([[2],[2]])
print(len(res),len(res[0]),res)
